name: Taiji (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Taiji town emblem in green: a stylised whale-like device with a curved tail enclosing a white ring.
history: Municipal flag of Taiji, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 September 1965.

features.role: Taiji town emblem — a stylised whale-like device with a curved tail enclosing a white ring
